title: The Layers list says how many of the things it picked are inside copies
goal: Save a colour as a style, press Select What Uses This, and the Layers list says 4 layers selected while showing only two rows, because the other two are pieces inside copies of a component and copies have no rows to open. The user has settled it: the list should say how many of the picked things are inside copies, so the number and the rows stop disagreeing without anything being hidden.
notes: Reproduced 2026-09-12 with Scripts/playtest/style-users-walk.json (run it with --no-build). The walk paints one rectangle, saves its fill as the style Accent, groups it with a second rectangle, makes a component and drops one copy. The style then reads 4 colors use this and Select What Uses This picks Rectangle, Rectangle 2, Rectangle, Rectangle 2 - the originals two children and the copys two pieces. See /tmp/photonz-playtest/style-users/styleusers-4-selected-sc.png and the earlier capture at /tmp/photonz-playtest/style-piece/stylepiece-5-typed-sc.png, which shows the list reading 4 layers selected over two visible rows.\n\nThe numbers themselves are honest: Position & Size shows over that mixed selection (the section is only taken away when a piece is picked ON ITS OWN, InspectorPanel.swift:791), and typing 900 into X moved the original with the copy following, so nothing on screen ended up saying two different things. This is about what the selection LOOKS like, not about a wrong number. Found while answering find-out-whether-position-and-size-takes-numbers.
acceptance: After Select What Uses This picks pieces inside copies, the Layers list says both numbers: how many were picked in total and how many of those are inside copies
The number the list shows never disagrees with the rows it is showing without saying why
A selection with nothing inside a copy reads exactly as it does today, with no extra words
A walk claims it on the case this was filed from: a saved colour, Select What Uses This, two rows and four picked

log.note: It is a question about what the list should say rather than an investigation, so it is on a card instead of a runner slot.
decision "Select What Uses This picks pieces inside copies, so the Layers list says four selected over two rows. What should it say?" resolved: Say how many are inside copies
